title: Speculative enquiry: graduate site engineer (Atherton Tablelands, Far North QLD)
apply_instructions: No advertised vacancy. RCG's careers page invites applications by email to recruitment@robinsoncivil.com.au.
rationale: Regional civil contractor whose published work is road construction, rehabilitation, stabilisation and drainage for TMR, the road geometry, pavement and stormwater areas Marc designed in Civil 3D and AutoCAD in his Advanced Diploma.

Its careers page quotes an engineer who started there as a site engineer in 2019 and mentions award winning training, which suits Marc's site inspection, quality check and site record work in the Philippines.
Far North Queensland is a regional move from Melton; Marc's regional and FIFO availability is on record and letters say only that he is open to discussing relocation.
contributions: Site inspections, quality checks, site reports, material records and progress reports during construction (Philippines 2019 to 2020)
Reviewing drawings and checking work against project requirements (Philippines 2019 to 2020)
Road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D (Advanced Diploma coursework)
caution: No vacancy is advertised; the recruitment inbox may simply hold the CV on file. Far North Queensland would mean relocation, which Marc must confirm before any interview.
gaps: Site experience is under one year and was in the Philippines, not on Australian road projects
No TMR specification or stabilisation experience
Relocation to Far North Queensland not yet confirmed by Marc
employer_line: Robinson Civil Group is a family owned Far North Queensland civil contractor based at Wondecla whose projects page lists road rehabilitation on the Millaa Millaa to Malanda Road and road safety improvement packages on the Kennedy and Palmerston Highways for the Department of Transport and Main Roads.
